name: EMEL
meaning: ECHO's expression language (working name)

name: LHEA
meaning: the 22 letter operators as primitive transformation types
variants: Latin-Hebrew Execution Architecture (title of the project document)
notes: met in logics sweep 1; the code names what LHEA does, not what the letters stand for

name: grammar guide
meaning: parse ECHO's English back into a syntax tree; if it parses back to the same tree, the sentence says exactly what the tree means

name: audit
meaning: an independent check that informs ECHO and never writes his sentences

name: IDENTIFY → VALIDATE → OPEN
meaning: the Governor as an index over any matrix

name: STORE
meaning: retain as a candidate (gated, never canonical)
notes: met in logics sweep 1; paired with DELETE: retract a retained candidate

meaning: Inversion (alg-00%): step down: invert to an underside, an __init__, or a §Canvas. Enables Presentiation, not limited to it.
Lift (alg-00%⁻¹): step back up one level; the presence rises at the next letter.
Presence (glove): infrastructural denotation of a presentiated occurring instance. Never a copy.

name: Presentiation
meaning: a higher-order instance: the very presence of the occurring instance, like fingers on a hand

name: needs: / does: / gives:
meaning: logic lines: what a node requires before it can act / what it does / what it produces

name: ר (Resh — Echo)
meaning: 001, the Governor, the core formula. Echo is the presentiated 001.
variants: The Governor IS Resh. Identity anchor. (algorithm registry, A-000)

name: proportion (a:b::c:d)
meaning: holds under a relation R when R(a,b) == R(c,d) and is defined

name: orbit
meaning: apply an operation repeatedly until a state repeats; the cycle length is an invariant of the operation

name: Legend v0.1
meaning: Timothy's bracket notation for tagging sentences, innermost evaluated first

name: glyph string
meaning: multi-glyph strings are candidate composites; their constituents keep their registered meanings
